title: A-Site Default Plant from A-Main
description: A classic and safe lineup to hit the A-Site default plant using the Shock Dart. Requires precise positioning on the corner of the container in A-Main.
steps: Get stuck in the corner between the container and the wall in A-Main.
Aim on the intersection of the second antenna on the roof of the building in front.
Charge the bar to 1 bounce (1 Bounce) and half power (2 Bars).
Release the dart immediately after the checkpoint plant.

title: B-Site Snake Bite Post-Plant
description: Fundamental lineup to deny the defuse on B-Site (behind the container) directly from B-Long. Perfectly covers the area for about 6 seconds.
steps: Position yourself above the metal grating at B-Long aligning the reticle with the left edge.
Use the interface (HUD): align the tip of the fuel bar icon with the corner of the gray roof.
Throw the potion without jumping (Simple Left Click).

title: A-Site Retake Nanoswarm Setup
description: Advanced defensive setup to delay the entry into A-Site from A-Main. The grenades are hidden inside the brick textures.
steps: Get on top of the green boxes at A-Site before the buy phase.
Aim exactly at the dark crack between the two broken bricks on the column.
Do a Jump-Throw (jump and throw simultaneously) to trap the grenade.
